notes: French read by an English speaker. English borrowed heavily from French, so a great many pairs are identical once accents are folded (nation, table, question). The skeleton folds French accents and the conventions the two spell differently for one sound; -tion, -ique/-ic and -eur/-or fall out of the edit distance without needing rules of their own. Threshold 0.70, the standard, chosen so a pair has to survive both the form and meaning axes rather than looking alike alone.
